voice.summary: Sounds like an engineer writing a README for a friend: precise, understated and a bit wry. It states sizes, guarantees and commands, and trusts code samples to do the persuading.
dos: Give real numbers like 1.2MB and ten seconds
Show a command or query instead of an adjective
Keep jokes to one dry line
donts: Do not claim to be the fastest without a benchmark
Do not hide the install command

taglines: A database small enough to hold
One binary. No server. Real SQL.
Small enough to read, strong to ship
A query planner on a postcard
boilerplate: Tessel is an open-source, embeddable SQL database delivered as a single 1.2MB binary with no server, ACID transactions and a query planner small enough to read in one sitting.

microcopy.error: Syntax error near line 1. Check the query.
microcopy.empty: No rows. Run a query to see results.

logo.note: A tessellating grid of tiles is the pun in the name and suits tabular data.
